choices.content: Every probability is at least \(0\), and all probabilities sum to \(1\)
The sum of the probabilities equals the number of values
Probabilities can be negative as long as they sum to \(1\)

question.prompt: What conditions must a probability distribution table satisfy?

solutions.explanation: Probabilities cannot be negative, and the probabilities of all possible values must sum to exactly \(1\).
solutions.title: Distribution conditions
